turns.question: What was net revenue on 1 October 2026, after partner returns?
turns.answer: Net revenue on 1 October 2026 was EUR 964.19, which is revenue minus partner returns for that single day. Fresh: returns.silver is ready up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
